domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee's application for leave of a given type over a date range, progressing through an approval lifecycle.

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's entitlement, used, and remaining leave days for a policy within a fiscal year.

domain_entities.name: Employee
domain_entities.purpose: Represents an employee who applies for leave and whose manager approves or rejects requests.

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlement configuration governing a leave type.

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories an employee may apply for.

domain_entities.name: Notification
domain_entities.purpose: Represents a notification delivered to an employee or manager about leave events.

domain_entities.name: AuditRecord
domain_entities.purpose: Records every state-changing operation on leave domain entities for auditability (GP-002).

business_rules: Leave duration in days is computed as endDate - startDate + 1 (inclusive of both start and end dates, calendar days). [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest duration / LeaveBalance deduction appears, not only here]
A leave request may only be submitted when startDate <= endDate; otherwise it is invalid. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest appears, not only here]

Approving a leave request deducts its inclusive day count from the employee's LeaveBalance.usedDays and remainingDays for the matching policy and fiscal year, atomically with the status change and audit record. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest approval / LeaveBalance appears, not only here]

A leave request cannot be approved if the requested inclusive day count exceeds the employee's remainingDays for the applicable policy and fiscal year. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest approval / LeaveBalance appears, not only here]
Only the employee's manager (Employee.managerId) may approve or reject a leave request. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest approval/rejection appears, not only here]

Cancelling an APPROVED leave request restores the previously deducted days to the employee's LeaveBalance. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest cancellation / LeaveBalance appears, not only here]
Every state-changing operation on a leave domain entity writes an audit record (GP-002). [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest / LeaveBalance / LeavePolicy appears, not only here]
A leave request may only be submitted by an employee whose employmentStatus is ACTIVE. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest submission / Employee appears, not only here]
A leave request may only reference a LeavePolicy whose isActive is true. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest / LeavePolicy appears, not only here]
domain_notes: Domain model reconstructed from docs/DOMAIN.md (canonical). Entities: LeaveRequest (lifecycle DRAFT→SUBMITTED→APPROVED/REJECTED, plus CANCELLED), LeaveBalance (ACTIVE/CLOSED), Employee (ACTIVE/INACTIVE/TERMINATED), LeavePolicy (ACTIVE/INACTIVE), LeaveType enum (annual/sick/emergency/unpaid/maternity/paternity), Notification (PENDING/SENT/READ/ARCHIVED), AuditRecord. Foundational semantics: leave duration is inclusive calendar days (endDate - startDate + 1) — recorded as broad rule so all call sites (sufficiency check, deduction, cancellation restore) share one definition. Approval deducts days atomically with status change + audit (service-owned unit of work per AGENTS.md). Manager-only approval/rejection; ACTIVE employee and ACTIVE policy required. Open questions remain on canonical balance entity name (Balance vs LeaveBalance), status enum type name (LeaveStatus vs LeaveRequestStatus), and audit entity shape/naming convention — these need chief-architect resolution before data/application architects proceed.

open_questions.question: Which balance entity is canonical: Balance or LeaveBalance (near-duplicate definitions in docs/DOMAIN.md)?
open_questions.impact: Determines the single entity name used across services, repositories, and audit entityType values; duplicate definitions risk divergent implementations.
candidate_options: Treat as aliases of one entity

open_questions.question: Is LeaveRequest.status typed as LeaveRequestStatus or LeaveStatus?
open_questions.impact: Affects the type name referenced in the entity, DTOs, and query params; the enum values (DRAFT/SUBMITTED/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED) are defined under LeaveStatus but the field references LeaveRequestStatus.
candidate_options: Rename to a single canonical enum

open_questions.question: Which audit entity shape and field naming convention is canonical among Audit, AuditLog, AuditRecord, and AuditServiceInterface (camelCase vs snake_case)?
open_questions.impact: Determines the audit record fields written by every state-changing operation (GP-002) and the entityType/action vocabulary used across modules.
